query_contract: For each frozen selected (ticker, declaration_date), inspect only ordered session dates strictly after declaration_date through the tenth row. Do not read OHLCV magnitudes, returns, outcomes, Gate metrics, or candidate results.
required_endpoint_contract: A treatment row is executable only when the canonical cold-plus-hot overlay contains a next-session row and ten ordered post-declaration session dates; entry is the first row's open and H10 exit is the tenth row's close in the later replay.
exact_roster_rule: The replay roster is the 94 frozen readiness selections minus exactly the five sorted (ticker, declaration_date) keys above; no further row may be added, dropped, substituted, or repaired after return access.
comparator_slot_rule: Within each declaration date, order executable treatment rows by their already-frozen liquidity rank and ticker. Match the first treatment slot to the one actual same-date cash-feasible core slot when present and not the same ticker; otherwise match it to cash. Match every additional treatment slot to cash. A core slot and its return may be consumed at most once. A same-ticker treatment/core collision is matched to cash and may not manufacture replacement value against itself.
